reset.docs: This [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) allows you to reset the value of the integration sensor to zero. For example this can be used to reset the integration sensor to zero at midnight with a time-based automation.

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the integration sensor.

*See also: [Integration Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/integration#sensorintegrationset_value-action)*

value.docs:
**float**: The value to set the integration sensor to.

*See also: [Integration Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/integration#sensorintegrationset_value-action)*

set_value.docs: This [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) allows you to set the integration sensor to a specific value. For example, it can be used to set the sensor to the battery capacity when it is fully charged.

integration_method.docs:
**string**: The integration method to use. One of `trapezoid`, `left` or `right`. Defaults to `trapezoid`.

*See also: [Integration Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/integration#configuration-variables)*

restore.docs:
**boolean**: Whether to store the intermediate result on the device so that the value can be restored upon power cycle or reboot. Warning: this option can wear out your flash. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [Integration Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/integration#configuration-variables)*

sensor.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the sensor to integrate over time.

*See also: [Integration Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/integration#configuration-variables)*

time_unit.docs:
**string**: The time unit to integrate with, one of `ms`, `s`, `min`, `h` or `d`.

*See also: [Integration Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/integration#configuration-variables)*
